body: I rush to the back of the property, my footsteps echoing through the quiet street. The crate, unmarked, bears an eerie resemblance to the one my neighbor had previously used. The words "Please sign here" are etched on its side in plain sight. A sense of unease grips my chest as I approach it cautiously. I notice no other signs of recent use, but something about the crate seems... deliberate.
